title: First conditional and future time clauses - Real future conditions

options.answer: If it will rain, we will stay home.
If it rains, we will stay home.
If it rain, we will stay home.

explanation.en: In first conditional sentences, use present simple in the if-clause and will + base verb in the main clause.
explanation.ru: В условных предложениях первого типа используйте настоящее простое время в условной части и will + основная форма глагола в главной части.
explanation.uz: Birinchi shartli gaplarda if qismida hozirgi sodda zamon, bosh qismda esa will + fe'lning asosiy shakli ishlatiladi.

options.answer: When you will arrive, call me.
When you arrive, call me.
When you arrives, call me.

explanation.en: In future time clauses with 'when', use present simple, not future tense.
explanation.ru: В придаточных времени с 'when' используйте настоящее простое время, а не будущее.
explanation.uz: 'When' bilan bo'lgan vaqt ergash gaplarida kelajak zamon emas, hozirgi sodda zamon ishlatiladi.

options.answer: Unless you don't hurry, you'll be late.
Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
Unless you will hurry, you'll be late.

explanation.en: 'Unless' means 'if not', so don't use additional negation. Use present simple after 'unless'.
explanation.ru: 'Unless' означает 'если не', поэтому не используйте дополнительное отрицание. После 'unless' используйте настоящее простое время.
explanation.uz: 'Unless' 'agar... -masa' degan ma'noni bildiradi, shuning uchun qo'shimcha inkor ishlatilmaydi. 'Unless' dan keyin hozirgi sodda zamon ishlatiladi.

options.answer: As soon as I will finish work, I'll go home.
As soon as I finish work, I'll go home.
As soon as I finished work, I'll go home.

explanation.en: After time expressions like 'as soon as', use present simple for future actions, not future tense.
explanation.ru: После выражений времени типа 'as soon as' используйте настоящее простое время для будущих действий, а не будущее время.
explanation.uz: 'As soon as' kabi vaqt ifodalovchi so'zlardan keyin kelajakdagi harakatlar uchun kelajak zamon emas, hozirgi sodda zamon ishlatiladi.

options.answer: If she doesn't studies, she won't pass.
If she doesn't study, she won't pass.
If she won't study, she won't pass.

explanation.en: In negative if-clauses, use 'doesn't' + base verb, not 'doesn't' + verb with -s or future tense.
explanation.ru: В отрицательных условных предложениях используйте 'doesn't' + основная форма глагола, а не 'doesn't' + глагол с -s или будущее время.
explanation.uz: Inkor shartli gaplarda 'doesn't' + fe'lning asosiy shakli ishlatiladi, 'doesn't' + -s qo'shimchali fe'l yoki kelajak zamon emas.

options.answer: Before you will leave, turn off the lights.
Before you leave, turn off the lights.
Before you leaving, turn off the lights.

explanation.en: After 'before' in future time clauses, use present simple, not future tense or gerund.
explanation.ru: После 'before' в придаточных времени используйте настоящее простое время, а не будущее время или герундий.
explanation.uz: Kelajak vaqt ergash gaplarida 'before' dan keyin kelajak zamon yoki gerundiy emas, hozirgi sodda zamon ishlatiladi.

options.answer: I'll help you if you will ask me nicely.
I'll help you if you ask me nicely.
I'll help you if you asked me nicely.

explanation.en: In first conditional sentences, the if-clause uses present simple, not future or past tense.
explanation.ru: В условных предложениях первого типа условная часть использует настоящее простое время, а не будущее или прошедшее.
explanation.uz: Birinchi shartli gaplarda if qismi hozirgi sodda zamonni ishlatadi, kelajak yoki o'tgan zamonni emas.

options.answer: After we will have dinner, we'll watch TV.
After we have dinner, we'll watch TV.
After we had dinner, we'll watch TV.

explanation.en: After time conjunction 'after', use present simple for future actions, not future perfect or past tense.
explanation.ru: После союза времени 'after' используйте настоящее простое время для будущих действий, а не будущее совершенное или прошедшее время.
explanation.uz: 'After' vaqt bog'lovchisidan keyin kelajakdagi harakatlar uchun hozirgi sodda zamon ishlatiladi, kelajak mukammal yoki o'tgan zamon emas.

options.answer: If it's sunny tomorrow, we go to the beach.
If it's sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.
If it will be sunny tomorrow, we'll go to the beach.

explanation.en: In first conditional sentences, use present simple in the if-clause and will + base verb in the main clause.
explanation.ru: В условных предложениях первого типа используйте настоящее простое время в условной части и will + основная форма глагола в главной части.
explanation.uz: Birinchi shartli gaplarda if qismida hozirgi sodda zamon, bosh qismda esa will + fe'lning asosiy shakli ishlatiladi.

options.answer: While you will be cooking, I'll set the table.
While you are cooking, I'll set the table.
While you cook, I'll set the table.

explanation.en: After 'while' for simultaneous future actions, use present continuous to show ongoing action, not future tense.
explanation.ru: После 'while' для одновременных будущих действий используйте настоящее продолженное время для обозначения длительного действия, а не будущее время.
explanation.uz: Bir vaqtda bo'ladigan kelajak harakatlar uchun 'while' dan keyin davom etayotgan harakatni ko'rsatish uchun hozirgi davom zamon ishlatiladi, kelajak zamon emas.
